text:
Aisha (Design): quick check on the trace viewer tweaks I pushed: compact header + new correlation chip. figma: https://figma.com/file/trace-compact
Tom (Eng): looks good. Q: how should keyboard users copy the correlation id?
Aisha (Design): plan: make the chip focusable, Enter copies. tooltip shows "Copied!"
Lena (Eng-UX): add aria-label on the chip: "Copy correlation id 9a8b" and aria-live region for the toast. also contrast: the grey timestamp fails small text.
Ravi (Product): copy wording: prefer "Copy ID" rather than just an icon. export: show format in menu: "Export (HAR)".
Tom (Eng): implementation note: navigator.clipboard.writeText + fallback. also ensure aria-expanded on frame chevrons.
Aisha (Design): microcopy changes: header "Request & trace", stack CTA "Expand frames", export split button.
Lena (Eng-UX): suggest a skip link: "Skip to frames" for SR users. add aria-controls between chevron and frame list.
ops-bot: Automated a11y scan: 2 warnings - timestamp contrast & missing aria-expanded. CI: https://ci.internal/scan/1780
Tom (Eng): I'll do the ARIA and copy toast PR next sprint.
Ravi (Product): I'll add A/B test card for collapsed-by-default vs expanded.
Aisha (Design): I'll update figma and report back. :thumbsup:
